How do I find Stoat servers to join?
Search Stoatmod Discovery by name, topic or tag, or browse categories such as gaming, anime, art and music. Open a listing to read its description and activity, then use its Stoat invite to join.
What is Stoatmod Discovery?

Stoatmod Discovery is a free directory of Stoat servers. Every listing is submitted by the server's owners and reviewed before it appears, and each server gets its own page with its description, tags and live activity.
Choose a community and open its invite link. Sign in to Stoat or create an account if prompted, then follow the invite to join and read the server's rules.
Is Discovery approval a safety guarantee?

No. Approval means the listing passed Stoatmod's directory review and met its requirements. Approval is a directory review, not a safety endorsement of every community or message, so read a server's rules before joining.
How can I advertise my Stoat server?
Add Stoatmod to your server, give it its permissions, add a server icon and turn on public statistics. Then apply from the Discovery tab of the Stoatmod dashboard. Listing and bumping are free.
Is advertising my Stoat server on Discovery free?
Yes. Applying, being listed and bumping your listing are all free. There are no paid placements: listings are ordered by activity, bumps and how recently they were approved.
What do I need before I can list my server?

Stoatmod must be in your server with all of its audited permissions, and your server needs an icon and public statistics turned on. You also need a Stoat invite link, a 20–500 character description and up to five tags.
Why does Stoatmod need a role and permissions?

Stoat bots only get the permissions of the roles you give them. Give Stoatmod a role with its permissions and move it above your members' roles, otherwise it cannot moderate them and your server will not be eligible.
How long does review take?
Most applications are reviewed within a day. You can see the status in the Discovery tab of your dashboard, and Stoatmod posts the decision to your log channel.
What is bumping?
Bumping moves your listing to the top of the Recently bumped list and the featured spot. Run ~bump in your server or use the dashboard; you can bump once every two hours.
Can my listing be removed?

A listing is hidden if the server stops meeting the requirements, if its owners make a material edit that has not been reviewed yet, or if it is revoked for breaking the Discovery rules. Material edits return to review before publication. A denied application can be resubmitted after seven days.
